description:
Project Overview

The Institute of Chemical Research of Catalonia (ICIQ) invites applications for a fully funded PhD position within its Fully-Funded PhD Programme 2026 – Third Call. The project, "AI-Accelerated Photochemical Upgrading of Pollutants in Flow," is led by Dr. Jesús Sanjosé-Orduna and Prof. Mónica H. Pérez-Temprano.

The research focuses on developing photochemical methods for upgrading pollutants into valuable chemicals using continuous flow technology, accelerated by artificial intelligence and automation.

Research position overview

You will join a newly established research group at ICIQ and work at the interface of photochemistry, flow chemistry, and data science. The project aims to develop sustainable methods for recycling harmful pollutants and transforming them into useful products.

Research Areas

  • Photochemical pollutant upgrading
  • Continuous flow chemistry
  • AI and automation in synthesis
  • Sustainable chemical processes
  • Catalysis and green chemistry
